messages:
kevin-support: 15:04 UTC — heads up: ACME (tenant: acme-inc) opened a ticket: p95 for /v1/generate jumped from ~120ms to ~1.8s and p99 to ~4.2s over last 30m. customers seeing 502s + long tails.
kevin-support: Symptoms: steady request rate with small fanout (3 parallel downstream calls). Auth tokens appear valid. Billing shows a sudden token consumption spike for acme-inc. Attaching repro steps.
kevin-support: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: acme-inc" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model": "embed-4", "input": "short prompt", "fanout": 3}'
```
oncall-bot: alert: ingress-service high p99 latency for tenant=acme-inc (alert_id=ingress-high-p99-9812)
julia-eng-sre: taking this. Kevin, can you paste a request_id from the customer logs?
kevin-support: request_id=abc1234 span=ingress:ing-78f
julia-eng-sre: looking at traces — queue depth jumped on worker pool w-embed-4. concurrency cap is 64 per shard; observed ~120 inflight causing admission waitlist and head-of-line blocking. KV cache miss rate up ~4x.
sasha: observed auth-ms latency spiking to ~300ms around same window; some retries started piling up at ingress.
mike: billing note: acme-inc hit a burstpad uplift yesterday and their token usage doubled — might explain sudden increased concurrency.
anya: suggested mitigations: 1) temp throttle tenant to 10rps; 2) enable fast-fail for embeddings backend for this tenant; 3) increase concurrency on w-embed-4 to 96 while we investigate; 4) collect GPU kernel/queue metrics.
julia-eng-sre: rolling canary now — change: pool w-embed-4 concurrency 64 -> 96; max_batch_size 64 -> 48 to reduce batching latency. deploying to 10% first. config patch:
```
pool: w-embed-4
concurrency: 96
max_batch_size: 48
admission_policy: tenant-specific-fastfail: true
```
ops-bot: deploy started: cfg-rollout/1805554321-canary
ops-bot: deploy succeeded on canary hosts (10%)
julia-eng-sre: metrics after canary: p95 down to ~220ms, p99 ~760ms, queue depth dropped. Fast-fail prevented embeds backlog.
kevin-support: I'll notify ACME with interim mitigations and ask for any recent client-side changes. Filing SUP ticket SUP-8672 with timeline and temporary throttle.
mike: action item: capture GPU utilization, kernel times, and auth-ms traces for window 14:40-15:10.
julia-eng-sre: agree — follow-up: we need root cause: auth retries or embedding backend degradation (maybe quantization/weights change). Opening internal bug INF-2943.
kevin-support: thanks everyone — we'll keep this thread updated. Postmortem sync tomorrow 11am PT.
